meta.title: High-Fit Staff + FDE Roles
meta.count_scope: Shortlisted roles only, not all company openings.
meta.history_note: This export preserves the October 5 report's 42-role snapshot. Earlier entries omitted by that report need individual reconciliation at the next research run.
meta.company_profiles_note: Company size, ownership and revenue are null pending sourced enrichment. Overviews reflect prior descriptions.

display.duplicate_policy: One role per application listing; alternate locations retained in location_text.

instructions: Preserve stable company/job IDs across refreshes.
Amounts are annual USD base salary; null is unknown, never zero.
NEW is relative to the report, not the original posting date.
report_date is not a verification date; show verification.last_verified_on separately.
Keep personal applied/saved notes outside this public dataset, keyed by job ID.
Retain dropped roles with reason/evidence rather than deleting history.
Company counts refer to shortlisted openings, not total hiring.
Financial stats require dated sources; distinguish revenue, ARR and valuation.
